data.name: Keep
data.description:
Heavy garrison and defensible position. Can be upgraded with weaponry. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned. 
When destroyed, Keeps become repairable Keep Ruins and sabotage the surrounding area for 60 seconds. Enemies within sabotaged area have reduced combat effectiveness. Keep Ruins can be restored if repaired at any point within 60 seconds and can be restored for up to 600 Stone, after which repairing becomes free.
data.descriptionCN:
重兵驻守，防御坚固，可升级武器。驻守时可增加额外攻击。
城堡被摧毁后，会成为可修复的城堡遗迹，并使周边区域在 60 秒内被破坏。处于破坏区域的敌人战斗能力降低。城堡遗迹可在 60 秒内随时修复恢复，修复最多需消耗 600 石料，之后修复免费。

data.name: Mustering Hall
data.description:
Holds technology from the Highlands and Lowlands. Each time a Landmark from a region is chosen, costs of their powerful technologies are reduced. Musters warriors using Food and Muster Charge costs. Each type of muster is one-time use.
Generates influence to military production buildings. Each building provides a count towards Muster Hall levels to improve its mustering efficiency and adds additional Muster Charges.
Comes with 1 Muster Charge by default.
data.descriptionCN:
包含高地和低地的科技。每当选择某地区的地标时，该地区强力科技的成本将降低。通过消耗食物和集合冲锋招募战士，每种集合方式仅能使用一次。
为军事生产建筑生成影响力。每座建筑都计入集合厅等级，提升集合效率并增加额外集合冲锋次数。
默认拥有 1 次集合冲锋。
